Plot S3 method for health system metrics

Source: R/plot.health_system.R
plot.cd_health_system_table.Rd

Draws the national health system metrics as a formatted table. The indicators are grouped under their section, each with its value and unit, and the year is shown in a line above the column headers.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cd_health_system_table'
plot(
  x,
  year = 2024,
  width = NULL,
  indicator_label = "Indicator",
  value_label = "Value",
  unit_label = "Unit",
  ...,
  options = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An object of class cd_health_system_table, as returned by generate_health_system_table().

year

The year to display in the header (defaults to 2024)

width

(Optional) Total width in inches. If NULL, autofit is used.

indicator_label

(Optional) Translated label for the Indicator column header

value_label

(Optional) Translated label for the Value column header

unit_label

(Optional) Translated label for the Unit column header

...

Additional arguments

options

(Optional) A cd_chart_options() object: text, legend, fonts and sizes a user changed. Applied last, so it wins over the arguments above; the plot's own defaults are used for whatever it does not set. Any chart option can also be given by name in ....

Value

A flextable object (from the flextable package), not a ggplot. Chart options change ggplots only, so options has no effect on this table.

Examples

cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
cache$adjust_data()
metrics <- cache$generate_health_system_table()

plot(metrics, year = 2023)
